Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the secretary of state to observe county election facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the secretary of state; and adding a new sectionto chapter 29.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary of state, or any staff of the elections division ofthe office of secretary of state, may make unannounced onsite visitsto county election offices and facilities to observe the handling,processing, counting, or tabulation of ballots.
